edges.effect_quant: The strongest quantitative studies point in a harmful direction, but the pooled magnitude varies across populations and methods.
edges.population: adults receiving oral or intravenous bisphosphonates
edges.mechanism: Very low jaw-turnover states, local trauma, and impaired healing around dental work help explain why osteonecrosis of the jaw clusters in heavily exposed bisphosphonate users.
edges.summary: The strongest piece here is the 2024 Adams meta analysis in Cochrane Database Syst Rev, which ties bisphosphonates to osteonecrosis of the jaw in a direction that later studies largely support. That makes this edge more about calibrating magnitude and context than arguing over whether the signal exists at all.
edges.caveats: Residual confounding and reverse causation remain possible in some observational studies, so the main readout is direction and plausibility rather than one exact risk number.
